heroHeadline: Day 589: Olinia EV Launch Confirmed for June 7; Chilapa Indigenous Hostages Safe; NYT Bomb Allegations Rejected; Bienestar Housing Target Raised to 60,000 Units
heroSubtitle: On May 13, 2026 (Day 589), President Sheinbaum's Wednesday mañanera delivered six major updates: (1) The official public launch of Olinia — Mexico's first federally-backed domestic electric vehicle built by 80+ Mexican academics over 18 months — confirmed for June 7, 2026; a cargo variant follows in July with manufacturing at 2,000 units/year from August–September. Olinia will feature in the June 11 World Cup opening at Azteca. (2) Approximately 100 indigenous people previously displaced or detained by Los Ardillos in Chilapa, Guerrero were confirmed safe; SEGOB coordinating reintegration for 800+ displaced families. (3) Sheinbaum rejected a New York Times report alleging the government used bomb attacks to eliminate criminal groups, calling the claims 'fictions.' (4) The CIA-Chihuahua unauthorized operations case — in which two CIA agents died April 20 — is now under formal investigation by both the Chihuahua State Prosecutor's Office and the FGR for violations of national security law and the Constitution. (5) Bienestar social housing national target raised from 44,500 to 60,000 units; 64 units delivered in Tabasco; Sheinbaum ordered INPI indigenous registry review for improved program access. (6) SEMAR Admiral Morales sank vessel 'Onjuku' off Tampico to create artificial reef; attended by Tamaulipas Governor Villarreal and SEMARNAT Secretary Bárcena. Backdrop: EU-Mexico Summit for formal treaty signing remains on schedule for May 22; USMCA first formal negotiating round on track for week of May 25.
